responsibility: Collects generic predicates for items by lowering user-written where clauses and bounds, adding special inherited predicates for RPITIT trait and impl items, combining inferred outlives constraints, injecting the implicit `Self: Trait` predicate for traits, and computing const-condition predicate sets and implied `~const` bounds used by later checking. It is specifically responsible for ensuring children of opaque types and return-position `impl Trait` items inherit the predicates of the parent item when needed. This matters for generic const expressions inside opaque return types, where an anonymous const or associated const path such as `T::ABC` must see parent bounds like `T: Foo` in its parameter environment.
